howto.name: Upload a fillable PDF form
howto.text: Drop a PDF with AcroForm fields up to 500 MB. The tool detects form fields automatically.

howto.name: Fill in the values
howto.text: Click Detect form fields. Each field is listed with its name and type: type into text fields, tick checkboxes and choose radio button and dropdown options from their lists. Signature fields cannot be filled here; use E-Sign PDF for a visible signature.

howto.name: Download the filled form
howto.text: Click Fill. The PDF is returned with values populated. Field structure is preserved so the form can be filled again later.

faq.q: How do I know what the form field names are?
faq.a: You do not need to. Detect form fields lists every field with its name, type and current value, ready to fill, without changing anything. Developers can get the same list from the /api/fill-form/fields endpoint.

faq.q: Can I flatten the filled form?
faq.a: Yes — run the Flatten tool afterwards to bake the values into the page content, so they can no longer be edited as form fields.

faq.q: Does this work on signed forms?
faq.a: Filling a signed form invalidates the signature. Sign last, after filling.
